The main takeaway from our work is that

the magnetic field in star-forming regions can be strongly modified by collisions, which can affect the evolution of the star-forming cloud as a whole, the formation of protostars and protostellar accretion disks, and the dynamics of protostellar jets.
the magnetic field in the process of star-formation is not a passive agent, but it is strongly coupled to the gas dynamics.
a full description of the evolution of the interstellar magnetic field requires the inclusion of the effects of collisions between charged particles.
